    Location

    Behaviour

    The boss will change targets frequently, so it's better to trap it in the spot west of the room where it won't be able to move to another target.

    The Nightmare Beast attacks in melee range.

    Strategy

    The boss itself isn't very hard to deal with, though everyone should be careful because it can deal up to 1000 damage just using its distance attacks. In order to succeed in the fight, however, the team must be organized and take turns in using the Totem in the room to create Dream Catchers and remove the curse that is applied to one character at a time, otherwise this person will be kicked out of the room. If there are 5 players doing this in a previously determined order, the boss fight shouldn't be very complicated to kill using Sudden Death Runes and single-target ammunition.

    Most of its attacks seem to deal Death Damage, so protection against this element is probably the best to use during the fight.
